summary: Tested Claude AI Models integration (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 4.5) in the AI Doubt Assistant. All 6 backend tests pass and frontend UI works end-to-end with proper model selector and response labeling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1770+ lines; consider splitting routers by domain (auth, courses, doubts, bookings, admin) into separate modules for maintainability.

Doubts endpoint silently swallows AI errors (only logs). Consider returning ai_error field or 502 so the frontend can inform users when a model fails; currently is_ai_response would just be false with no explanation.
AI_MODELS dict allows any unknown ai_model to silently fall back to gpt-5.2. Prefer explicit 400 validation for invalid model ids.
